annotations.title: Get one error issue with stack traces

description: One issue in full: the group, its 50 most recent occurrences with stack traces, release and environment, and 30 days of daily counts. This is the tool to reach for when asked to fix a production error. When the app uploaded source maps, each occurrence also has `stack_resolved` and `frames` (original file, line, column and function; `in_app` marks the app's own code) — read those instead of the minified `stack`. An occurrence with a trace_id can be opened with get_trace.
name: get_error_issue
